deceiver

  • CURIE: gmeow:roleDeceiver
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/roleDeceiver
  • Category: individual
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/deception

The participant in a deception event who projects a standpoint that diverges from what they hold true. In self-deception, this role is borne by the same entity as roleDeceived.

Structure

Types: gmeow:ParticipantRole

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:roleDeceiver as a controlled value typed as gmeow:ParticipantRole.
